email.subject: Family Dentistry: two quick site fixes
email.body:
Hi Aisha,

Looked at Family Dentistry's site. Two things are likely costing you patients: there's no click-to-call button, so mobile visitors searching "dentist near me" can't tap to call and probably just move to the next result. And there are no reviews showing on the site, which matters a lot for dental since people check reputation before booking.

I fix exactly this kind of thing for a flat fee, no retainer.

Want a free 10-minute walkthrough where I show you both issues on your actual site and what I'd change? No pitch, just the screen share.

Alex
Northlight Web
